title: A Space website's free subdomain sends visitors to the custom domain once that domain is live

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14: Once a user has established a custom domain, their subdomain site should redirect to their main site.

detail: A page request on <slug>.frequencylocal.com whose Space has a live custom domain (spaces.domain bound through boundSiteDomain, which carries the custom_domain gate, and the website published: the same test as the profile canonical's siteTwinCanonical, now liveSiteDomain in lib/sites/site-domain.ts) answers with a permanent 308 to https://<domain> on the same path. The decision is the pure subdomainSiteRedirect in lib/sites/host.ts (host, path, query, bound domain to a target or null), unit-tested in host.test.ts. It runs in the site's page routes (app/hosted/[host]/page.tsx and [page]/page.tsx through redirectSubdomainToLiveDomain in lib/sites/hosted.ts), not the proxy: the proxy has no cached host-to-Space read and runs on every request, while the pages are ISR, take the host as a route param, and already make the same boundSiteDomain read for their canonical, so the redirect is cached with the page and re-rendered when the owner's domain change expires the site:<slug> tag. Never redirected: /admin and /admin/* (the owner's editor and handoff), /api, /confirm-booking (a one-time emailed link), /spotlight-click, the share card, and robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt, which already name the bound domain as the site's one origin. The custom domain itself and a subdomain with no live domain never redirect, and /sites/<slug> keeps forwarding to /spaces/<slug>. Open: a static page cannot see the query string, so the route-layer redirect drops it (the pure function carries it for a future proxy caller).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=p=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const h=r('lib/sites/host.ts');const hs=r('lib/sites/hosted.ts');const d=r('lib/sites/site-domain.ts');const home=r('app/hosted/[host]/page.tsx');const pg=r('app/hosted/[host]/[page]/page.tsx');const t=r('lib/sites/host.test.ts');const bad=[];if(!h.includes('export function subdomainSiteRedirect'))bad.push('no subdomain redirect decision');if(!h.includes('first === SITE_ADMIN_SEGMENT'))bad.push('the admin pages are not kept on the subdomain');if(!d.includes('export async function liveSiteDomain')||!d.includes('readWebsitePublished'))bad.push('no live-domain check');if(!hs.includes('permanentRedirect(target)'))bad.push('the hosted resolve never redirects');for(const [n,f] of [['home',home],['page',pg]])if(!f.includes('redirectSubdomainToLiveDomain(host, space'))bad.push('the '+n+' route does not redirect');if(!t.includes('subdomainSiteRedirect'))bad.push('the decision is untested');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-896: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
